events.name: KvK – Kingdom of Power
events.when: Every 4 weeks: matchmaking Sat–Sun, prep Mon–Fri, battle Sat 10:00–22:00 UTC
know: Nothing to register. Matchmaking runs by itself and the opponent shows on Sunday.
Prep days: Mon City Construction, Tue Basic Skills Up, Wed Pet Training, Thu Hero Development, Fri Power Boost.
Only speedup items score in prep. Gems to finish timers and beast hunting score nothing.
The kingdom that wins prep attacks, and the castle fight happens in the loser's kingdom.
Battle day: 10:00–12:00 open fighting, 12:00–17:00 King's Castle, 17:00–22:00 open fighting.
Kills only score against cities within 3 Town Center levels of yours.
After 22:00 Field Triage opens for about two days. Each member sends 20 Rescue Orders and can receive 50.
todo: Before prep: hold speedups, Truegold, roulette spins, hero shards, taming marks, forgehammers and widgets.
Train troops one tier below your best and keep them for Thursday promotions.
Every prep day: spend on that day's theme and open all three daily chests.
Can't play on battle day? Shield before 10:00 UTC with cover until 22:00.
Battle day: join the rallies the War Lead calls, never march on the castle alone, heal in small batches.
At 22:00: open Field Triage and send all 20 Rescue Orders.

events.name: Castle Battle
events.when: Saturdays 12:00–17:00 UTC, about every two weeks, and inside KvK
know: The castle goes to the first alliance to hold it 2.5 hours in a row, or the longest total hold in 5 hours.
Four turrets fire on the castle holder. An alliance holding turrets weakens the castle garrison.
Two hours before the start, cities inside the alert zone are moved out at random.
Troops at the castle are wounded, not killed, unless your infirmary overflows.
todo: Take the turret or rally job the War Lead gives you.
Join rallies with the first-slot hero you are told to use.
Reinforce garrisons when asked, and heal in small batches.

events.name: Bear Hunt
events.when: Every 2 days at the alliance's fixed hour
know: A 30-minute damage race with no troop losses. It pays forgehammers and hero gear chests.
Only R4 and above can start it. You have a 46-hour personal cooldown across both traps.
Each trap level adds 5% attack, up to 25% at level 5. Arrowheads from intel missions level it up.
todo: Joiners: first-slot hero Chenko, Amadeus or Yeonwoo, then Amane or Margot.
Never put Jabel, Gordon, Edwin, Long Fei, Helga or Diana first. Join with no hero instead.
Troop mix: 10% infantry, 10% cavalry, 80% archers.
Bring all troops home from gathering before the hunt starts.
Donate Explosive Arrowheads until the trap is level 5.

events.name: Viking Vengeance
know: 20 waves hit member cities and the alliance HQ in about 40 minutes.
Waves 7, 14 and 17 hit online players only. Waves 10 and 20 hit the HQ.
Rewards depend on the whole alliance's result. Shields do not work.
todo: Empty your city: infantry and cavalry reinforce allies who are online, archers stay home.
Swap reinforcements with your group about one hour before the start.
Lead reinforcements with Chenko, Amadeus, Yeonwoo or Amane.
Do not heal during the event.

events.name: Tri-Alliance Clash
events.when: Monthly: vote Mon–Tue, sign-up Wed–Thu, matchmaking Fri, battle Sat
know: A 60-minute battle with three alliances from different kingdoms. Troops are copies, so nothing real is lost.
Officers pick up to 30 fighters plus 10 substitutes. Only confirmed players get a spot.
Minute 0–20 seize buildings, 20–40 Garrisons, 40–60 Temple.
Leaving early locks you out for 12 minutes.
todo: Answer the roll call by Thursday if you can play.
Be online 10 minutes before the slot and stay the full hour.
Follow the Captains the War Lead appoints on the field.

events.name: Swordland Showdown
events.when: Every 2 weeks: vote, register, matchmaking, battle on Sunday
know: A one-hour Legion against Legion battle, won on points from held buildings. Troops heal for free when you leave.
Points per minute: Swordshrine 1,800, Sanctum 1,200, Abbey 600. Kills only give personal points.
Alliance rewards follow Legion 1, so the most reliable players go there.
todo: Answer the roll call if you can play Sunday.
Empty your infirmary before you enter.
Hold buildings; do not chase kills.

videos.title: Kingshot Swordland Showdown: Complete Guide, Strategies, and Tips to Maximize Rewards

events.name: Sanctuary Battle
events.when: Weekly: sign-up from Tuesday, battle on Friday
know: We fight for one Sanctuary and one Fortress on the kingdom map. Losses are 30% wounded, none dead.
Only members in the rally that clears the NPC garrison get the participation chest.
A contested building needs 30 minutes of unbroken control.
todo: Join the War Lead's NPC rally until it is full.
After the clear, garrison the building with infantry and cavalry.

videos.title: KINGSHOT- Strategy guide for Sanctuaries and Fortresses

events.name: Alliance Championship
events.when: Weekly: register Mon to Wed 23:00 UTC, rounds Thu to Sat
know: An automatic tournament: 6 alliances, 5 rounds, 3 lanes. You do not need to be online.
We need at least 10 registered marches. Officers move people between lanes before each round.
todo: Register your march before Wednesday 23:00 UTC (Town Center 10 or higher).
Switch on pet, appointment and city buffs before you register.
Troop mix: 50% infantry, 20% cavalry, 30% archers.

events.name: Alliance Mobilization
know: A mission race against 19 other alliances. Top 3 move up a league, bottom 3 move down.
Good value: train troops, 20 forgehammers, 10 Terrors or 30 beasts, gather 30M.
todo: Do your two personal missions first.
Accept only missions you can finish today.
Skip missions that eat speedups or shards in a KvK week.

events.name: Caesar's Fury
know: A personal PvE ladder that starts by itself. You lock one difficulty at the start.
Officers summon alliance Captains once enough members reach the required level. A Captain escapes 30 minutes after the scout.
todo: Lock the highest difficulty you can fully clear.
On a Captain call: tag with a one-troop march first, then send full marches when told.
Use all your Accords before the last day ends.

events.name: Alliance Brawl
events.when: The week after KvK, Monday to Sunday
know: A daily development race against an alliance from another kingdom. There is no fighting.
You must be in the alliance by Sunday 23:00 UTC before it starts to count.
A caravan escort or raid is worth 10,000 points every day.
todo: Run all caravans and raids every day.
Spend on each day's theme only; keep a reserve for the weekend finale.

videos.title: Kingshot alliance brawl ultimate guide. Win without compromising your prep.

events.name: Blizzard Brawl
events.when: Two days, four match windows a day
know: A solo 10-player match of 10 minutes. Town Center 25 or higher.
Points come from holding the Vault and camps, not from kills.
todo: Play all 6 matches of the season.
Bring all marches home and switch off auto-join before you queue.

events.name: Merchant Empire
know: Four caravans and four raids a day. Allies cannot raid each other.
Only squads on the assistance list can be invited to help.
todo: Send all four caravans every day, not right at server reset.
Post an assisting squad on the list.
